atlasPromptPrefix: Create an opaque photoreal cinematic GAME ART TEXTURE ATLAS for a premium collection catalog. Only output the atlas. EXACT layout: a single landscape image made of SIX separate equally sized rectangular product photographs in a perfectly aligned regular 3-column × 2-row grid, zero gutters, zero margins, zero dividers, zero frames, no compositing across cell edges. Crop guides at precisely one third and two thirds of width and half height. The final atlas will be cut at these coordinates. Consistent eye-level commercial product stills with distinct real-world settings: one CLOSED tactile collectible CS2 loot case per cell. The ENTIRE case is visible including corners and handle, centered a little ABOVE vertical center, case occupies roughly 65–72% of the cell width and under 55% of cell height, sky/ground breathing room for a wide horizontal crop. Clean PBR material definition, soft volumetric backlight, crisp key light on the case, legible from thumbnail size, controlled highlights, natural deep shadows, rich cinematic contrast. Each specific case has an entirely unique form, materials and conspicuous abstract emblem. Surfaces and atmosphere fill each background to cell edges. No printed words, numbers, text, UI, typography, logos of real brands, people, guns, labels, watermarks or stickers with writing. No open case. Case designs need to look like real fun sculptural examples of legendary equipment loot, NOT carry-on luggage in colors, not six variants of the same prop. Dramatic contemporary video game key art, not cartoon. Every panel has its own world and its own chosen accent. Aspect ratio of overall sheet can be very wide landscape, e.g. 2304×1024 if supported. Precisely three columns and precisely two rows. Compose specified six panels in reading order.

Center the chest, occupying around 68 percent of canvas width, 52 percent of height, with generous enough breathing room for horizontal or square product-card crops, subject midpoint at 51% height. Elegant slightly dark environmental set, bright silver key light edging the top and front, atmospheric red streaks.
